change: 035 components (TabPFN-3.5 seeds 0/100/200 on 4 U-Net feature variants, equal mean, fixed W=0.75) with 4 new label-free columns per variant: het4_u, het4_u_mx (pixel-weighted 4x4 block Hall-Petch size heterogeneity from that variant's U-Net log-area maps) and z_f25, z_f50 (area fraction of grain pixels with predicted darkness z>0.25 / z>0.5 from new multi-task U-Net unet4-z1 with a per-pixel grain-darkness regression channel).
why: 035 residual on clean rows correlates with pixel-weighted block size heterogeneity (+0.13; centroid version used before: +0.03). Segmentation f_dark_20 / f_dark_50 carry hardness information beyond the U-Net phase (partial corr +0.12 / -0.16); the z channel gives the same information noise-robustly (z_f25 +0.16/+0.16, z_f50 -0.16/-0.18 beyond U-Net phase, clean/noisy halves).
selection_notes: het4_u/het4_u_mx chosen from 6 U-Net block stats by 035 dev residual correlation; z_f25/z_f50 chosen from 7 z readouts by partial correlation on train labels. Mild selection bias expected (~0.02-0.04).
